<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant M peak, an M+1 peak at ~6.7 % of M (consistent with ~6 carbons), and rapidly diminishing higher‑mass peaks—the only element with a characteristic pattern that can be definitively confirmed is carbon. No chlorine, bromine, or sulfur patterns are present.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
